In accordance with the terms of the above-referenced lease, the United States of America, acting by

30daysnotice ofits option to renew said lease for the period of10/1/2021 through9/30/2022.All
conditions and provisions of the said lease andany amendments thereto, are hereby extended to
cover the renewal option period.
The considerations, acts, promises, agreements, and provisions to be executed and performed by
each party to said lease shall remain in full force and effectfor the above-referenced period.This
renewal is conditioned upon the passages of an applicable appropriation or authorization by
Congress from which this expenditure may bemade and shall not obligate the United States upon
failure of Congress to so act.
